memories.summary: Mara took up pottery/ceramics and has a recurring glazing day with Wen; she finds it the one place her brain goes quiet and the most fun she's had (as of 2026-05-30).
On 2026-05-30 Mara dipped a small bowl in a celadon green glaze and won't know how it fired until the following week.
Wen observed (2026-05-30) that Mara has 'stopped strangling the clay,' i.e. has grown more relaxed and skilled at pottery; basis: working alongside her on glazing day.
Mara is still floating from Dan's recent visit; he texted that he's 'looking into things' in Toronto, which she reads as vague but is choosing to be hopeful about (2026-05-30).
Mara had a good week (2026-05-30) but downplays admitting it, joking she has a reputation to protect, reflecting a habit of guarding against showing she's doing well.
